feeds.title: International Gallery of Contemporary Art Blog
feeds.description: The International Gallery of Contemporary Art (IGCA) serves as a vibrant platform for new visual and interdisciplinary art forms. It fosters an environment for diverse artists and audiences to converge, encouraging bold ideas and experimentation. IGCA inspires vision and discovery, advocating for artistic risk-taking and innovation.

feeds.title: Real Art Is Better
feeds.description: Welcome to the Real Art Is Better blog, run by Scott Clendaniel and Maria Benner in Anchorage, Alaska. Scott, an oil painter, specializes in beer paintings among other subjects. Maria manages the business side. The blog covers Scott's art, business insights, Alaskan life, and their adventures.

feeds.title: 14 Mile Farm Blog
feeds.description: At 14 Mile Farm, Jasmine crafts artisanal textiles with deep intention, from hand-dyed yarns to handwoven luxury fabrics. As a weaver, healer, and mother living in an Alaskan cabin, she shares stories in fibre, wool, and cloth, offering wearable art and heirloom home goods imbued with love and magic.

feeds.title: Sitka Art Blog
feeds.description: At Sitka Art Blog, Rebecca Poulson an artist and publisher based in Sitka, Alaska, channels her passion for her community into creative endeavours. Through projects like The Outer Coast calendar of art and poetry, she aims to capture the essence of Sitka's vibrant culture. Currently delving into the history of Sheldon Jackson School and College, her work uncovers unexpected narratives, challenging assumptions and inspiring her forthcoming book.

feeds.title: James Johnson Blog
feeds.description: James Johnson, an acclaimed Tlingit Artist and Carver from Juneau, AK, showcases his mastery of traditional wood carving and Tlingit form line design. His work serves as a visual language, preserving Tlingit history and culture while embracing contemporary practices rooted in indigenous traditions.

feeds.title: Fairbanks Arts
feeds.description: Fairbanks Arts, Alaska's foremost community arts council, champions excellence in contemporary and traditional arts in the Interior. Serving as the official arts organization for Fairbanks, it offers diverse programming in performing, literary, and visual arts, backed by dedicated community volunteers.

feeds.title: Pastel Society Alaska Blog
feeds.description: The Pastel Society Alaska organizes charity auctions, with proceeds aiding various causes. In 2022, they assisted a Ukrainian artist displaced by conflict. Their ongoing commitment to philanthropy reflects a growing and compassionate community, poised to support future causes in need.

feeds.title: Art with my Coffee
feeds.description: Welcome to Art with my Coffee, where Christine Lewis, a self-taught artist originally from Maine, shares her passion for painting the breathtaking landscapes of Juneau, Alaska. Her artwork reflects the awe-inspiring beauty of nature, conveying the emotions and serenity she experiences outdoors.

feeds.title: Sketches of Alaska
feeds.description: Explore Ray Bonnell's Sketches of Alaska blog, where the Alaskan artist, historian, and writer from Fairbanks shares his passion for Alaska's history and landscapes. Through his art and words, he educates and preserves the state's rich heritage, offering insights into an artist's life in Fairbanks and his travels across Alaska.

feeds.title: Corinne Danzl Blog
feeds.description: Corinne Danzl, along with her husband Keith, embodies the Alaskan spirit through art and outdoor adventures. With a deep appreciation for nature and a love for Gyotaku, Corinne continues the legacy of Ink Goes Wild Alaska, passed on to her by her friend and predecessor, Iva Cooney. Together, they celebrate the beauty of Alaska's wilderness through their artistic endeavours and outdoor pursuits.

feeds.title: Pamela Sue Art & Designs Blog
feeds.description: Pamela Sue, an Alaska-based artist, printmaker, and small business owner, infuses her creations with the beauty of nature and vintage craftsmanship. Her cheerful artwork, including prints, cards, and custom pieces, aims to illuminate lives and celebrate the wonders of the natural world.

feeds.title: Tangle Alaska Blog
feeds.description: Donna Jacobson, an author, fiber artist, and Certified Zentangle Teacher based in Anchorage, Alaska, shares her passion for arts and crafts through teaching and writing. With a focus on Zentangle, Donna has been guiding students both locally and online since 2014, witnessing their creative growth firsthand.

feeds.title: Bead Art by Deb McQueen
feeds.description: Deb McQueen, a self-taught Seed Bead Artist from North Pole, Alaska, intricately crafts her pieces to evoke the essence of nature's elements. With a blend of vintage, antique, and new seed beads, her work captures the fluidity of water and the gentle sway of wind through meticulous stitching. Deb's art has garnered recognition in various Juried Art Exhibitions, earning accolades such as Honorable Mentions, 3rd and 2nd place awards, and Jurors Choice Awards.

feeds.title: Jeffrey H Dean Blog
feeds.description: Jeffrey Hannum Dean is driven by an intrinsic need to create, whether it's art, inventions, or architectural projects. For him, making things is not just a conscious decision but an essential outlet for his boundless creative energy. His website offers insights into his diverse projects, from sculptures to innovative solar thermal systems, showcasing his unique approach to craftsmanship.

feeds.title: Katherine Hocker
feeds.description: Katherine Hocker, a Juneau native, spent her childhood immersed in the wilderness, fostering a deep love for nature and science. With a passion for art and an insatiable curiosity, she juggles numerous creative projects simultaneously, from book illustrations to commissioned paintings, reflecting her diverse interests and talents.
